description: Upload a media file (image, video or document) from a URL or local file path. The file is stored in BulkPublish for use in posts. Supported formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, MP4, MOV, WebM, and documents (PDF, Word .doc/.docx, PowerPoint .ppt/.pptx). Max 100MB. A document has no thumbnail or preview and can only be published to LinkedIn, as a `document` post. Provide either url OR filePath, not both. Returns the stored file under file, including file.id to pass in mediaFileIds on create_post. Use this when the user provides an image, video or document to attach to a post.

file.description: A file provided by the chat host. Leave unset and use url otherwise.

download_url.description: Temporary download link for the file.

file_id.description: The chat host's own identifier for the attached file. Not a BulkPublish media ID.

mime_type.description: The file's MIME type, e.g. image/png, when the host knows it.

filePath.description: Absolute path to a local file to upload (e.g. /Users/me/photo.png).

filename.description: Optional filename. If omitted, derived from the URL or file path.

url.description: Public URL of the media file to upload.

name: upload_media

file.description: The stored media file. file.id is what mediaFileIds takes.

title: Upload media
